Judge Orders Release of Kennedy Center Donor Records Amid DOJ Secrecy Bid

A judge has ordered the Kennedy Center to release financial records related to a donor, a move the Department of Justice (DOJ) is reportedly fighting to keep secret, particularly concerning former President Trump's role. The donor has also been identified as a secret FBI informant.
